# Generate e2e — clean success (default verify, git default).
# Destination under $GEN_ROOT (0700 custody-safe parent).

mkdir $GEN_ROOT/parent
chmod 0700 $GEN_ROOT/parent

exec foundry generate --spec examples/minimal-cli.toml --dest $GEN_ROOT/parent/minimal-cli --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"commit_outcome":"committed"'
stdout '"plan_sha256"'
stdout '"network_disclosure"'
stdout 'go-mod-tidy'
! stderr .
exists $GEN_ROOT/parent/minimal-cli/go.mod
exists $GEN_ROOT/parent/minimal-cli/.git
dump_digest stdout
